alternate_text: [Franken only] During setup, take the Dark Pact promissory note as an additional component, and you may choose Blood Pact as an optional component in place of your drafted promissory notes; you have 2 faction promissory notes.

When you win a combat, place 1 command token from your opponent's reinforcements in your fleet pool if it does not already contain 1 of that player's tokens; other players' tokens in your fleet pool increase your fleet limit but cannot be redistributed.

[Franken only] When you win a combat, place 1 command token from your opponent's reinforcements in your fleet pool if it does not already contain 1 of that player's tokens; other players' tokens in your fleet pool do not increase your fleet limit and cannot be redistributed. While another player's command token is on your command sheet, you can use the ability of that player's commander, if it is unlocked.

[Franken only] When you research a unit upgrade technology, you may return 1 captured unit of that type to ignore all of the technology's prerequisites. If you do not have the Amalgamation ability, you may only have one captured unit of each non-fighter ship type in your play area.

[Franken only] During setup, place the Lady flagship token in your reinforcements with your chosen drafted Flagship and place both drafted Heroes next to your faction sheet. The Lady flagship token is a second flagship unit with the abilities and attributes listed on the Lady flagship card. You have 2 Heroes.

[Franken only] ACTION: Each other player rolls a die for each of their non-fighter ships that are in or adjacent to a system that contains your Space Dock; on a 1-3, capture that unit. If this causes a player's ground forces or fighters to be removed, also capture those units. Then, purge this card.

[Franken only] Midir - Living Will (The Edyn Mandate) | Golden Order - Peace Eternal
ACTION: For each system with at least one of your mechs on the game board, draw 1 agenda. Reveal and resolve each agenda in any order as if you had cast 1 vote for an outcome of your choice. Other players cannot resolve abilities during this action.

Then, purge this card.

1 warsun (or flagship if no warsun tech)
2 fighters
4 infantry
1 space dock
Choose up to 2 technologies with 0 prerequisites owned by no other player.
Choose 2 technologies in the same color with no prerequisites.
Choose 2 technologies in different colors with 1 total prerequisite.
